title: Absorb the four module role tables into PlatformRoleAssignments
problem: Four module-specific role tables hold live authorization data alongside the shared table Batch C built to replace them; two systems answer one question
evidence: Wave 1 fixtures had to seed AccountingUserRoles AND PlatformRoleAssignments to make one decision meaningful
business_value: One place to grant and audit; Batch D2 console cannot be honest without it
technical_value: Removes the largest duplication in the authorization layer
risks: Live authorization data; needs read-both/write-new migration
test_approach: Per-module parity tests: identical decisions before and after

title: Make bootstrap-open explicit per company and auditable
problem: Three modules return true for EVERY action when their role table is empty for the company; invisible at runtime
evidence: A dedicated guard test was required asserting permission IS granted with no role rows
business_value: A new tenant is safe by default
risks: Flipping the default would lock out unconfigured installs
compatibility_impact: Ship as explicit flag defaulting to today's behaviour plus first-run warning
test_approach: Assert both flag states per module

title: Validate the EF relational model against SQL Server DDL
problem: GenerateCreateScript is rejected by SQL Server (FK_Branches_CountriesLookup_CountryID multiple cascade paths); model never validated against the real engine
evidence: F4 hit it directly; production schema is hand-written SQL
technical_value: Model and DB currently allowed to disagree with no failing test
risks: Changing cascade behaviour blindly would alter deletion semantics in a reverse-never-delete codebase
test_approach: Test enumerates ALL rejected constraints; compare model to sys.foreign_keys

title: Make SessionValidation unmistakable for authorization
problem: Sits on 257 mutating actions and proves only that a session exists
evidence: Stage 1 had to repeatedly restate that it is not authorization
compatibility_impact: Rename or annotate; no behaviour change
test_approach: Assert the attribute carries a non-authorization marker

title: Per-request authorization decision log
problem: Denials are logged individually; no single place to ask why a request was refused
evidence: Stage 1 logs are per-service
test_approach: Assert a decision trail exists for an allowed and a denied request

title: Mark superseded maturity and permission records
problem: Eight maturity records and three superseded permission figures (151/54/183 152/55/181) with no marker
evidence: A reader cannot tell which figures are current
test_approach: Assert only one record is marked current

title: Generalise the TaskScopeQuery set-based pattern
problem: Proven no-N+1 pattern is Tasks-only; HR WMS Projects all need set-shaped reads
evidence: 1 permission evaluation for 500 rows, proven
business_value: Large-list screens stay fast as modules grow
test_approach: Reuse the evaluation-count test per consumer

title: Unified audit and history framework
problem: Per-table CreatedBy/At only; no unified history
evidence: No audit table exists
test_approach: Per-capability audit assertions

title: Enterprise search
problem: No search capability exists
evidence: No search index or service in source
test_approach: Relevance and permission-trimming tests

title: AI context framework
problem: AI endpoints are authentication-only with no context model
evidence: 4 AiController endpoints in the backlog
test_approach: Assert AI retrieval respects permissions

title: Object-level permission trimming for portals
problem: No portal exists; trimming would be unused
evidence: No portal in source
test_approach: Trimming tests per object

title: Retention and archival
problem: No retention policy
evidence: No volume pressure evidenced
test_approach: Retention window tests

title: Full rewrite of any module
problem: No source evidence supports a rewrite
evidence: Stage 1 showed targeted enforcement works
risks: Would discard working accounting stock and POS logic

title: 20 analyzers in Stage 2A
problem: Only two are evidence-backed
evidence: Scanner misread 38 endpoints; 46 tests falsely skipped
risks: False positives teach developers to suppress diagnostics

title: Blockchain digital twin IoT now
problem: No business case in source
evidence: Absent from all requirements and code

title: Low-code studio
problem: Requires stable Registry workflow engine and permission trimming
evidence: None of the three exist

title: Force every entity into one base class
problem: Entities already persist with divergent conventions (TaskItem.CompanyId vs CompanyID)
evidence: Observed in source

title: Fix 908 company constants inside a feature wave
problem: Large mechanical change to calculation-bearing controllers
evidence: Inventory 267 Accounting 201
risks: Folding it into a wave makes the wave unreviewable

title: Enterprise Design System
problem: 327 existing views with duplicated UI patterns and no shared token or component layer
evidence: 327 .cshtml files; Master Data alone forecasts ~26 screens
business_value: Consistent bilingual UI across hundreds of future screens
technical_value: One token+component layer instead of per-screen CSS
compatibility_impact: Additive; no mass rewrite in Phase 0
test_approach: Visual regression on a sample set; RTL/LTR parity

title: Domain Catalog
problem: 224 DbSets and 39 controllers with no documented domain ownership
evidence: 224 DbSets; 16 scanner module buckets incl. a 232-action DevTools bucket
test_approach: Generated from source, not hand-maintained

title: Business Capability Map
problem: End-to-end flows (Lead to Cash, Procure to Pay) are not documented across modules
evidence: Modules exist; no cross-module flow documentation found
business_value: Shows where flows break for users
risks: Can become aspirational rather than evidence-based
test_approach: Trace each flow to real endpoints

title: API and Integration Catalog
problem: 289 API actions, 3 hubs, 8 workers with no consolidated contract, auth or idempotency record
evidence: 289 API actions across 10 controllers; 3 SignalR hubs; 8 hosted services
test_approach: Assert every API surface has a documented auth mode

title: Enterprise UX Review of existing screens
problem: Existing screens predate the design system and vary in pattern
evidence: 327 views; POS/KDS/lane screens use divergent models legitimately
technical_value: Identifies real reuse before extracting components
risks: Mass rewrite risk - explicitly out of scope
test_approach: Sample-based review, not a sweep

title: WMS reclassified: Partial Build on an existing bin foundation
problem: I previously reported WMS as absent. BinLocation and BinStock EXIST
evidence: Models/Context/Inventory: BinLocation, BinStock classes present
business_value: Correct scoping prevents rebuilding a foundation that exists
risks: My earlier Full Platform Build classification was wrong
test_approach: Inspect bin usage before designing Stage 4

title: Manufacturing reclassified: routing and work centres already exist
problem: I previously reported no routing or capacity. ManufRoutingOp and ManufWorkCenter EXIST
evidence: Models/Context/Inventory: ManufRoutingOp, ManufWorkCenter, ManufPlan, ManufPlanDemand
business_value: Correct scoping; missing piece is scheduling not routing
technical_value: Stage 5 scope shrinks to capacity levelling
risks: My earlier classification overstated the gap
test_approach: Inspect routing usage before designing Stage 5

title: Separate storefront presentation fields from the Item master
problem: StoreOldPrice StoreBadge StoreRating StoreVendor StoreHoverImage are e-commerce display concerns on the master record
evidence: Item has 39 properties, 5 of them storefront presentation
risks: StoreController reads these and carries parallel-team changes
test_approach: Assert storefront rendering unchanged

title: Reconcile duplicated barcode and image sources
problem: Item.Barcode coexists with ItemBarcode table; Item.ImagePath coexists with ItemImage
evidence: Both pairs present in Inventory.cs
technical_value: Removes a duplication class already seen in roles and company sources
risks: Retiring a column used across modules
test_approach: Parity tests on barcode lookup and image rendering
